proposals.before: With 50,000 troops, and the Left General Xun Zhi from Liaodong to attack Right Channel.
proposals.after: With 50,000 troops, and the Left General Xun Zhi from Liaodong, to attack Ugeo.
proposals.reason: 右渠 is the personal name Ugeo, not a place name 'Right Channel'.

proposals.before: Right Channel sent troops to defend the dangerous passes.
proposals.after: Ugeo sent troops to defend the dangerous passes.
proposals.reason: 右渠 is Ugeo's name, mistranslated as 'Right Channel'.

proposals.before: Right Channel defended the city, saw that the tower ship army was small, immediately came out of the city to attack the tower ships, the tower ship army was defeated and scattered in flight.
proposals.after: Ugeo defended the city, saw that the tower ship army was small, immediately came out of the city to attack the tower ships; the tower ship army was defeated and scattered in flight.
proposals.reason: 右渠 is Ugeo, not 'Right Channel'.

proposals.before: The Son of Heaven, because neither general had achieved victory, sent Wei Shan to use the army's might to persuade Right Channel.
proposals.after: The Son of Heaven, because neither general had achieved victory, sent Wei Shan to use the army's might to persuade Ugeo.
proposals.reason: 右渠 is Ugeo, not 'Right Channel'.

proposals.before: Right Channel saw the envoy and bowed his head in apology: 'I wish to surrender, but fear the two generals will deceitfully kill me;
proposals.after: Ugeo saw the envoy and bowed his head in apology: 'I wish to surrender, but fear the two generals will deceitfully kill me;
proposals.reason: 右渠 is Ugeo, not 'Right Channel'.

proposals.before: With a crowd of over ten thousand people bearing arms, when they were about to cross the Hun River, the envoy and Left General suspected they would rebel, told the crown prince that since he had already submitted, the people should not bear arms.
proposals.after: With a crowd of over ten thousand people bearing arms, when they were about to cross the Pae River, the envoy and Left General suspected they would rebel, told the crown prince that since he had already submitted, the people should not bear arms.
proposals.reason: 浿水 is the Pae River elsewhere in this chapter; 'Hun River' is incorrect.

proposals.before: The crown prince also suspected the envoy and Left General would deceitfully kill him, so did not cross the Hun River, and led them back again.
proposals.after: The crown prince also suspected the envoy and Left General would deceitfully kill him, so did not cross the Pae River, and led them back again.
proposals.reason: 浿水 is the Pae River, not the Hun River.

proposals.before: The Left General broke the army above the Hun River, then advanced to the city walls, surrounding the northwest.
proposals.after: The Left General broke the army above the Pae River, then advanced to the city walls, surrounding the northwest.
proposals.reason: 浿水 is the Pae River, not the Hun River.

proposals.before: Right Channel thus firmly defended the city, after several months could not be taken.
proposals.after: Ugeo thus firmly defended the city; after several months it could not be taken.
proposals.reason: 右渠 is Ugeo, not 'Right Channel'.

proposals.before: Yin, Xi, Luo Ren all fled and surrendered to Han.
proposals.after: Yin, Xia, and Lu Ren all fled and surrendered to Han.
proposals.reason: 唊 is Xia (Wang Xia), and 路人 is Lu Ren, not 'Xi' and 'Luo Ren'.
路人 is Lu Ren, consistently so in the idiomatic rendering.

proposals.before: Wanggeom Fortress was not yet taken, therefore Right Channel's minister Cheng Ji again rebelled, attacked the officials again.
proposals.after: Wanggeom Fortress was not yet taken; therefore Ugeo's minister Cheng Ji again rebelled and attacked the officials again.
proposals.reason: 右渠 is Ugeo, not 'Right Channel'.

proposals.before: The emperor, for the beauty of his name, did not investigate, and appointed He as the Dongbu prefect of Liaodong.
proposals.after: The emperor, for the beauty of his claim, did not investigate, and appointed He as the Commandant of the Eastern Division of Liaodong.
proposals.reason: 東部都尉 is the eastern-division commandant, not 'Dongbu prefect'; 名美 refers to the impressive reported exploit.

decisions.reason: Focus unit 討右渠 names the Joseon king 右渠 (Ugeo) as the object of the campaign; reading it as a place 'Right Channel' invents a toponym. Replacing with Ugeo restores the personal name already used in the idiomatic and adjacent units.
右渠發兵距險 has 右渠 as the agent who deploys troops; it is the same personal name as in s0017, not a place. 'Ugeo sent troops…' corrects the mistranslation.
右渠城守…出城擊樓船 again treats 右渠 as the defending king who sallies out; 'Right Channel' is false. Ugeo is the correct personal name; the rest of the proposed literal preserves the Chinese sense.
往諭右渠 means Wei Shan is sent to admonish/persuade the person 右渠 (Ugeo). 'Right Channel' misreads the name as a place; the proposed replacement is accurate.
右渠見使者頓首謝 opens Ugeo's speech of apology; 右渠 is the speaker-king, not a channel. Replacing 'Right Channel' with Ugeo corrects the error without changing the quoted content.
方渡浿水 names 浿水, elsewhere in this chapter rendered Pae River (e.g. s0012, s0023 idiomatic). 'Hun River' is a wrong hydronym; Pae River matches the Chinese and chapter usage.
遂不渡浿水 again has 浿水; 'Hun River' is incorrect. Pae River is the established English for 浿水 in this chapter.
破浿水上軍 refers to forces on the upper 浿水 (Pae River), not a Hun River. The proposed literal corrects only that naming error.
右渠遂堅守城 has 右渠 as the defending king. 'Right Channel' is wrong; Ugeo is correct, and inserting 'it' before 'could not be taken' merely supplies a needed subject for 未能下.
陰、唊、路人 are abbreviated forms of Han Yin, Wang Xia (唊), and Lu Ren (路人) from s0049. Literal 'Xi' and 'Luo Ren' misread 唊 and 路人; 'Xia' and 'Lu Ren' restore the correct names.
路人道死 names 路人, already correctly Lu Ren in s0049's literal and the idiomatic here. 'Luo Ren' is a wrong romanization; Lu Ren matches the Chinese and chapter consistency.
故右渠之大臣成巳 marks Cheng Ji as minister of 右渠 (Ugeo). 'Right Channel's minister' invents a place-name owner; Ugeo's minister is the accurate reading.

上為其名美…拜何為遼東東部都尉: 名美 refers to the impressive reported exploit (killing a Joseon general), not She He's personal name-beauty; 東部都尉 is Commandant of the Eastern Division, not 'Dongbu prefect'. Both replacements match the Chinese and the idiomatic.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 上為其名美，即不詰，拜何為遼東東部都尉
